scripts.build: npm run admin:sync && rm -rf .next && next build --webpack
scripts.dev: ALTTEULMAP_ADMIN_MODE=embedded npm run admin:sync && next dev --webpack
scripts.e2e:prepare: lsof -tiTCP:3107 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs -r kill && rm -rf .next test-results playwright-report && mkdir -p .next/types .next/dev/types && printf 'export {};\n' > .next/types/routes.d.ts && printf 'export {};\n' > .next/dev/types/routes.d.ts
scripts.test:e2e:smoke:ci: playwright test tests/e2e/map.spec.ts tests/e2e/admin-dashboard.spec.ts tests/e2e/signup.spec.ts tests/e2e/submission-admin.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:full:ci: npm run test:e2e:smoke:ci && USE_MOCK_DATA=true playwright test tests/e2e/map.mobile.spec.ts --project mobile-chromium && playwright test tests/e2e/bookmarks.spec.ts tests/e2e/comments.spec.ts tests/e2e/price-review.spec.ts tests/e2e/report-admin.spec.ts
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.cf:build: npm run admin:sync && npm run cf:patch-next-runtime && npm run cf:clean && opennextjs-cloudflare build
scripts.preview:public: npm run cf:build:public && opennextjs-cloudflare preview -c wrangler.jsonc
scripts.preview:admin: npm run cf:build:admin && opennextjs-cloudflare preview -c wrangler.admin.jsonc
scripts.deploy:public: npm run cf:build:public && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy -c wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:admin: npm run cf:build:admin && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy -c wrangler.admin.jsonc
